info.title: Re.juve Gamification REST API
info.description: Dokumentasi RESTful API Lengkap Re.juve Gamification Platform (Authentication, Masters, Batches, Onboarding Journeys, Workstations, Multi-Role Approvals, Active New Recruit Report Traceability 17 Kolom, Flexible Avatar Handling, dan Integrasi Lynx ERP).

bearerAuth.description: Masukkan Token JWT dari endpoint POST /auth/login. Contoh: Bearer eyJhbGciOi...

tags.name: 0. System & WebSocket Console
tags.description: Status sistem, Swagger docs, dan konsol pengujian interaktif WebSocket

tags.name: 1. Authentication
tags.description: Otentikasi JWT, profil pengguna, dan reward Early Bird

tags.name: 8. Batch Generator
tags.description: Pembuatan Batch Onboarding, generator misi, dan fast-forward lock/unlock

tags.name: 9. Evaluations
tags.description: Alur Penilaian Terpadu (Buddy, SL, DM Review, Crew Feedback, Rapor Buddy, dan Riwayat Buddy)

tags.name: 10. Lynx Sync
tags.description: Webhook penerima & sinkronisasi manual dengan Lynx ERP

tags.name: 11. Dashboard & Analytics
tags.description: Ringkasan metrik dashboard realtime multi-role (Crew, SL, DM, Admin)

tags.name: 12. Gamification & Leaderboard
tags.description: Klasemen kru, podium top 3, dan perolehan bintang & level

tags.name: 13. Notifications
tags.description: Notifikasi in-app lonceng real-time untuk kru, store leader, dan DM

tags.name: 14. Feedback Kru Onboarding
tags.description: Survei pengalaman kolaborasi & onboarding 1 bulan Re.juve

tags.name: 15. Reports & Traceability
tags.description: Laporan Rekapitulasi Insentif Pembimbingan Buddy & Audit Jejak Penugasan Pengguna (Traceability)
